paper_title: Shifting Long-Context LLMs Research from Input to Output
caption: Proportion of real-user demand: The aforementioned 2K range refers to the interval [2K, 4K), and similarly for the other ranges. Solid color fill for input demand, slash fill for output demand in the Wildchat dataset.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the proportion of real-user demand across different input and output contexts within the Wildchat dataset. The horizontal axis details four categories: 2K-Input, 4K-Input, 8K-Input, and 16K-Input, each representing an interval as defined in the paper. The vertical axis, labeled "Number," displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 108494, with tick labels incrementing by 10000. Four bars are presented, each with a distinctive fill pattern, representing the demand for input, while a corresponding set of four bars, using a slash fill pattern, represents the demand for output. The shortest bar, 2K-Input, has a value of approximately 9320, displayed as a label above the bar, while the tallest bar, 16K-Output, has a value of approximately 108494, also labeled above the bar. The 8K-Input bar has a value of 78188, and the 4K-Output bar is 3784.  The remaining bars, 2K-Output, 8K-Output, and 16K-Input have values of 17865, 4247, and 832, respectively. The bars are sorted by category along the horizontal axis, and the solid fill bars are visually distinguishable from the slash-filled bars, highlighting the distinction between input and output demand.
